boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Thomas Aquinas College, California, rites that mark the academic year, from matriculation to senior milestones.

cards.title: Sign the College Registry
cards.subtitle: California campus · opening of the academic year
cards.notes: Watch each incoming freshman be called forward, greet the ceremony leaders, and sign the campus registry after the Mass of the Holy Spirit.
cards.short_summary: New students formally begin their tenure by signing the campus registry.
cards.evidence_claim: At the 2025 California Convocation, freshmen attended a Mass of the Holy Spirit, came forward by name, and signed the campus registry at Matriculation.
cards.source_title: TAC Matriculates Class of 2029 on Both Coasts
cards.access_notes: Ceremony timing and guest attendance are not stated on the cited page; check College announcements before planning.

cards.title: Mix Classes for One-Off Seminar
cards.subtitle: California campus · outside the regular curriculum
cards.notes: Join the cross-class discussion when announced, preparing the assigned non-curricular reading and bringing a question for the small seminar group.
cards.short_summary: Students from all four years discuss a selected text outside the ordinary curriculum.
cards.evidence_claim: The College calls its All-College Seminar a time-honored tradition that groups students from all four years for one-off discussions of readings outside the curriculum.
cards.source_title: All-College Seminar Grapples with Mercy and Justice
cards.access_notes: Topics and scheduling vary by semester; participation details are not stated on the cited page.

cards.title: Meet at the Senior-Freshman Dance
cards.subtitle: California campus · fall welcome tradition
cards.notes: Look for the senior-hosted welcome dance early in the fall and use its themed activities and dancing to meet the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: Returning classes host Saturday-night dances welcoming new freshmen.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reports that each fall returning classes take turns hosting Saturday-night dances for the new Freshman Class, including a California senior-freshman welcome dance.
cards.source_title: Seniors Welcome Freshmen with Dances on Both Coasts!
cards.access_notes: Themes and locations vary by year; consult current student-life announcements.

cards.title: Freshmen Send Off Seniors
cards.subtitle: California campus · finals-season gathering
cards.notes: When the Senior-Freshman Snack Night is announced, pause finals preparation for the freshman-hosted snacks, music, and conversation with seniors.
cards.short_summary: Freshmen and seniors gather shortly before graduation for an informal sendoff.
cards.evidence_claim: In 2025, freshmen on both campuses held the Senior-Freshman Snack Night; California freshmen served snacks in the Dumb Ox Café for seniors and freshmen.
cards.source_title: Freshmen Send Off Seniors with Late-Night Snacks
cards.access_notes: The cited page describes a post-curfew gathering but does not publish a recurring start or end time.

cards.title: Pick a Side at Upper vs. Under Soccer
cards.subtitle: California campus · end-of-year competition
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar near the end of the academic year, then watch the upperclassmen and underclassmen face off from the bleachers.
cards.short_summary: Students stage annual upperclassmen-versus-underclassmen soccer games.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the California upper-versus-underclassman soccer games as annual all-school competition held near the end of the academic year.
cards.source_title: Split Victories: Upper- vs. Underclassmen Soccer Championships at TAC-California
cards.access_notes: Dates and teams vary annually; the cited page does not provide future scheduling.

cards.title: Watch Tutors Take on Seniors
cards.subtitle: California campus · senior milestone
cards.notes: Head to the athletic field when the senior milestone is scheduled, and watch tutors and seniors play while classmates and families line the sidelines.
cards.short_summary: Tutors and seniors meet for an annual softball game before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies the Tutor vs. Senior Softball Game as an annual California senior milestone, with students and families watching from the sidelines.
cards.source_title: Seniors Best Tutors in Softball, Burn Thesis Drafts
cards.access_notes: The event is described as occurring one week before finals; confirm the current year's schedule with the College.

cards.title: Mark the Thesis Finish Line
cards.subtitle: California campus · senior thesis milestone
cards.notes: Observe the organized senior ceremony after thesis defenses; the College reports seniors each add draft pages and a remark to the communal moment.
cards.short_summary: Seniors ceremonially burn thesis drafts after completing and defending their theses.
cards.evidence_claim: The College calls the burning of Senior Thesis drafts a tradition marking seniors’ completion and successful defenses of their theses.
cards.source_title: Seniors Best Tutors in Softball, Burn Thesis Drafts
cards.access_notes: This is a College-organized senior ceremony; do not create an independent fire or burn materials outside event procedures.

cards.title: Ring the Thesis Bell
cards.subtitle: St. Cecilia Hall · California campus
cards.notes: At the senior thesis turn-in, listen for the bell after each registrar-accepted submission and celebrate classmates as their final drafts are logged.
cards.short_summary: California seniors mark an accepted thesis submission by ringing a ceremonial bell.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reported that California seniors traditionally gathered for thesis turn-in and rang a bell after the registrar accepted each final draft.
cards.access_notes: The cited account places the 2026 California gathering at 9 p.m. on Saturday; future timing is not confirmed.

cards.title: Hear the Senior Boast
cards.subtitle: St. Joseph’s Commons · California campus
cards.notes: After the seniors’ final exam, listen for the class’s loud accounting of tutorial hours, seminars, exams, papers, and thesis work.
cards.short_summary: Graduating seniors noisily recount four years of academic work to the lower classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says that every year, after their last exam, seniors gather in St. Joseph Commons for the Senior Boast, announcing completed work and what remains for lower classes.
cards.access_notes: Recent California coverage places the Boast after the final exam; the College does not publish a standing public schedule.

cards.title: See the Annual Chez Martin Dance
cards.subtitle: California campus · senior class’s final dance
cards.notes: Watch for the senior class’s final themed dance near graduation, including the student-created film or entertainment that precedes the dancing.
cards.short_summary: The senior class hosts an annual, themed final dance before graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes Chez Martin as the California senior class’s annual final dance, held as graduation approaches and themed by the hosting class.
cards.source_title: Fairground Fun Defies Rain at California Chez Martin Dance
cards.access_notes: The theme, program, and location can change; check current College announcements for attendance details.
